title: Welcome to PTA BLOG
summary: A sample article showing how your PTA BLOG will look. Replace or delete it when you're ready to publish your first story.
body:
This is an example post to demonstrate the blog layout. You can edit its title, images and text in Pages CMS, or delete it and create your own articles.

What can I share here?

PTA education, exam preparation, career experiences, and helpful questions from readers.

When comments are connected, visitors will be able to leave questions beneath articles without creating a Disqus account, provided guest commenting is enabled.
